Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You slip through the little space their weapon leaves behind.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent enemy and a visible free square within 2 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Pass along a legal route to that square without provoking from the chosen enemy. Other enemies can still react. You cannot pass through its occupied square.
